amendment.failure: Tensor-byte hashing rejected an empty zero-stride int64 label tensor before training.
amendment.scope: Hash-layout compatibility repair and production-collation regression tests. Same data, checkpoint, four conditions and seven updates.

comparison: Exact equality plus tensor-level magnitudes and first-difference values. No post-hoc tolerance or AP-based pass threshold.
decision: Report all conditions. Divergence is a diagnostic result, not a program failure. Invalid inputs, mutated observation state, nonfinite tensors or incomplete budget are explicit failures requiring review.
limits: Four serial conditions, one checkpoint, one seed and one machine are a causal debugging screen, not a variance estimate.
Instrumentation and pre-materialized inputs can change GPU timing; exact agreement here does not prove the archived smoke was deterministic.
No validation/test images or accuracy evaluation; no automatic longer training or resubmission.
The seven updates cover the archived interval of first known divergence; they are not an accuracy-learning budget.
question: Locate the first observed difference under identical inputs, separating plain repeat execution, frozen probing, and mid-run restore.

source_checkpoint.selection: Fixed first unaugmented epoch; not the validation-selected best checkpoint

treatment: All four conditions use the identical materialized geometry-only batches. Probe policy is recorded but never applied.
